name: Fara
description: Microsoft's open computer-use agent models with a CLI that completes web tasks in a Playwright browser.
whatItDoes: Fara takes a natural-language web task and carries it out by viewing the page and issuing mouse and keyboard actions. The models are small enough to self-host and are aimed at developers and researchers.
howItWorks: The fara-cli harness screenshots a Playwright browser, sends it to a Fara model served from Microsoft Foundry or a local vLLM server, and executes the predicted action until the task finishes. The endpoint is described in a JSON config file.

requirements.name: Model endpoint
requirements.description: Fara hosted on Microsoft Foundry (endpoint config JSON with api_key) or self-hosted with vLLM

run: fara-cli --task "whats the weather in new york now" --endpoint_config azure_foundry_config.json
